mappedSemantics: CSS comments and insignificant whitespace are removed without rewriting quoted strings.
Declaration values preserve required binary operator spacing inside calc/min/max/clamp math functions.
Shorter color keyword serialization mirrors common Lightning CSS outputs such as yellow to #ff0, blue to #00f, white to #fff, black to #000, and transparent to #0000.
URL tokens and custom property token streams are treated conservatively for WordPress theme CSS.
benchmarkDenominator.warning: This is a static inventory, not upstream runner parity. Native PHP progress maps 7 focused lane tests against a 241-behavior-check upstream denominator.

nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native CSS comment/whitespace minifier, declaration block parser, value-level color keyword shortening, and calc/min/max/clamp operator spacing.

wordpressScenario: Shared-hosting CSS transforms for themes, blocks, Playground, and plugin build-free delivery; fixture covers block theme custom properties, block selectors, color minification, and calc spacing.
nextTask: Port a small selector/tokenizer parser slice so the PHP implementation can distinguish selectors, declarations, at-rules, and nested rules before adding more transformer semantics.
